reporting-org.narrative: King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Centre

title.narrative: Providing life-saving water, sanitation and hygiene (WASH) services to earthquake-affected children and vulnerable people in Syria

description.narrative: Number of people benefiting from access to life-saving/emergency water, sanitation and hygiene facilities and services (3,100 women, 4,700 girls, 2,850 men, 4,350 boys) - Estimated number of people with access to improved water supplies (20,000 women, 32,000 girls, 19,000 men, 29,000 boys)
Providing life-saving emergency water, sanitation and hygiene services through access to improved water supplies and through repair and rehabilitation of earthquake-damaged water networks

Supported 15,000 beneficiaries with a comprehensive WASH package for water trucking, sludge removal, solid waste management, and latrine cleaning/maintenance - - Supported 100,000 with safe drinking water through repair and rehabilitation of damaged water networks
